# Qualcomm aptX

> Qualcomm aptX is Qualcomm's premium wireless audio codec technology enabling high-resolution, low-latency Bluetooth audio across smartphones, laptops, headphones, earbuds, and speakers.

aptX.com showcases Qualcomm's aptX and Snapdragon Sound wireless audio technologies, featuring product listings across multiple device categories and technical documentation for various aptX codec variants. The site serves as both a consumer resource for discovering aptX-enabled devices and a technical reference for audio codec specifications.

## Key Topics

- Snapdragon Sound
- aptX Adaptive
- aptX HD
- aptX Low Latency
- aptX Lossless
- Bluetooth audio codec
- High-resolution audio
- Low-latency gaming
- Wireless audio technology
- Audio devices
- Device compatibility
- Qualcomm
- Cambridge Audio
- ASUS
- beyerdynamic

## Getting Started

- [Qualcomm aptX: Wireless High Resolution Audio Via Bluetooth](https://www.aptx.com): Homepage showcasing Qualcomm aptX wireless audio tech and Snapdragon Sound
- [Qualcomm Snapdragon Sound Technology](https://www.aptx.com/snapdragon-sound): Core technology page explaining Snapdragon Sound and aptX features
- [Why choose a Qualcomm aptX enabled device?](https://www.aptx.com/which-aptx): Guide comparing aptX, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive, and Low Latency variants

## aptX Codec Technology

- [Qualcomm aptX Adaptive](https://www.aptx.com/aptx-adaptive): Technical specs for aptX Adaptive audio codec with adaptive bitrate
- [Qualcomm aptX HD](https://www.aptx.com/aptx-hd): Technical reference for aptX HD high-resolution 24-bit audio codec
- [Qualcomm aptX Low Latency Synchronised Audio Technology](https://www.aptx.com/aptx-low-latency): Technical specs for aptX Low Latency gaming and lip-sync audio codec
- [Qualcomm aptX Audio](https://www.aptx.com/aptx): Technical reference for original aptX wireless audio codec technology

- [Earbuds](https://www.aptx.com/earbuds): Wireless earbuds with Snapdragon Sound and aptX Adaptive audio
- [Speakers](https://www.aptx.com/speakers): Wireless speakers with Snapdragon Sound and aptX audio technology
- [Adapters](https://www.aptx.com/adapters): Bluetooth adapters and transmitters with Snapdragon Sound aptX tech
